title: Sensitivity Classification
description: A classification of how sensitive a data record is — determining access controls, retention, redaction, and disclosure rules. Applied to any OLP schema.

entity_type.description: OLP schema type being classified, e.g. 'legal-matter', 'medical-condition'

sensitivity_level.description: public: any authenticated user | internal: the subject and their agents | restricted: named individuals only | highly_restricted: named individuals with explicit need-to-know | sealed: court-ordered or statutory seal

sensitivity_categories.description: UK GDPR / DPA 2018 special category classifications where applicable

legal_basis.description: UK GDPR Article 9 legal basis for processing special category data

override_reason.description: Required when accessing above normal permission level
